canonical_short_form: Journey owns stable functional kernels and safety contracts. External projects own their expression profiles.
architecture_rule: No expression profile is ontologically primary. A profile may translate labels and presentation without changing authority, state, receipts or rollback behavior.

functional_kernels.perceive: Observe authorized state and surface evidence.
functional_kernels.regulate: Balance workload, conditions and resource use.
functional_kernels.route: Resolve ownership, destination and movement paths.
functional_kernels.synchronize: Coordinate timing, communication and shared state.
